notes_for_editor: Only the register is specific to this tower in the cache; the other two sources are statewide. Staffing and public access are not established, so no access key is set and the story says so. Lookout-site pages found by search (ffla.org and firelookout.org) returned 404 from the cache and were not quoted or used. Their search summaries say the tower is on Pinnacle Hill, gives 68 ft rather than the register's 70 ft, gives October 1, 1921 as first operation, and calls it an active state tower; none of that is in the story. The 1969 build year and the 1921 replacement rest on the register alone. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 3 readable page reads plus failed attempts.
